constraints.definition: CHECK (((result_mime IS NULL) OR ((media_type = 'image'::text) AND (result_mime = ANY (ARRAY['image/png'::text, 'image/jpeg'::text, 'image/webp'::text]))) OR ((media_type = 'video'::text) AND (result_mime = ANY (ARRAY['video/mp4'::text, 'video/webm'::text])))))

constraints.name: media_tasks_mode_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (((provider = 'router_creative'::text) AND (((media_type = 'image'::text) AND (model = 'gpt-image-2'::text) AND (mode = ANY (ARRAY['text_to_image'::text, 'image_to_image'::text]))) OR ((media_type = 'video'::text) AND (model = 'grok-imagine-video-1.5'::text) AND (mode = ANY (ARRAY['text_to_video'::text, 'image_to_video'::text]))))))

constraints.name: media_tasks_settlement_check
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((status <> 'done'::text) OR ((credit_state = 'settled'::text) AND (result_key IS NOT NULL) AND (result_mime IS NOT NULL) AND (result_bytes IS NOT NULL) AND (result_bytes > 0) AND (result_sha256 IS NOT NULL) AND (result_sha256 ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'::text))) AND ((status <> 'refunded'::text) OR (credit_state = 'refunded'::text)) AND ((status <> 'failed'::text) OR (credit_state = 'none'::text)) AND ((status <> ALL (ARRAY['reserved'::text, 'submitting'::text, 'waiting'::text, 'storing'::text, 'reconciling'::text])) OR (credit_state = 'reserved'::text))))

constraints.name: media_tasks_status_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (((status = ANY (ARRAY['preparing'::text, 'reserved'::text, 'submitting'::text, 'waiting'::text, 'storing'::text, 'reconciling'::text, 'done'::text, 'failed'::text, 'refunded'::text])) AND (credit_state = ANY (ARRAY['none'::text, 'reserved'::text, 'settled'::text, 'refunded'::text])) AND ((reconcile_stage IS NULL) OR (reconcile_stage = ANY (ARRAY['submission'::text, 'query'::text, 'storage'::text, 'accounting'::text])))))
